_README: The shared connection-type vocabulary — the stud sizes. Two organ ports connect iff their `type` matches. Curated deliberately: a new type is added only when no existing one fits (sprawl defeats the standard). Each type pins the shape that flows on that wire. See CONNECTORS.md.

TenantContext.desc: A resolved tenant: identity, branding, provenance bag.

SiteCrawl.desc: Signals crawled from a prospect's website at signup.

InterviewTranscript.desc: Ordered Q&A pairs from a discovery interview.

KeyFacts.desc: Themed facts extracted from a transcript (the discovery memory).

EntityGraph.desc: Deduplicated canonical entities (people, systems, tools) per tenant.

Blueprint.desc: The system blueprint: modules + integrations + current/recommended state.

ProcessFlow.desc: Sequence / swimlane of a workflow extracted from transcript themes.

AccountState.desc: A fleet account's pacing/quota state (the pace + drift gates' input).

ClaimVerdict.desc: Whether a worker may claim work now, and why (gate output).

BillingState.desc: A tenant's subscription / billing state + feature entitlements.

ConformanceVerdict.desc: Whether an organ/output conforms + groundedness (self_metric shape).

ApparatusSource.desc: A pointer to something the fresh apparatus should scan for useful specs/features — the OLD apparatus or any source.

RawArtefacts.desc: Raw scanned content from a source, before it is decomposed into discrete features.

CandidateFeatures.desc: Discrete specs/features decomposed out of the raw scan — the candidates to judge.

JudgedFeatures.desc: Candidates after judgment — the useful ranked, the useless rejected (reject is first-class).

ProvenancedArtefact.desc: Any spec/feature the scan-and-select takes from the OLD apparatus, wrapped with its origin + succession status so the new machine knows it as inherited, never native. Retain history, know it as such — succession baked in, the antidote to old-artefacts-polluting-new. See FRESH_APPARATUS.md.

PullRequestList.desc: A bare array of GitHub pull-request descriptors carrying RAW GitHub API fields, the read-only input to merge-queue triage. Distinct from PendingItems: PendingItems is the post-normalisation {items:[{id,atoms}]} shape the generic prioritiser consumes; PullRequestList is the pre-normalisation GitHub shape that organ-ae-pr-queue itself atomises (mergeable bool/None, check_runs, reviews timeline, changed_files). Used for both the queue (`prs`) and the recently-merged set (`recently_merged`) compared for duplicate detection. organ-persona-seed-dedupe consumes a projection of this shape (number/title/state/merged/url/body/updated_at) as its pre-fetched `candidates`.
PullRequestList.schema: array<{id:any, number:int, title:str, html_url:str, state:str, merged_at:str|null, mergeable:bool|null|str, check_runs:array, reviews:array, changed_files:array, body:str, additions:int}>

SeedDedupeVerdict.desc: The persona seed-dedupe decision: whether a persona's about-to-be-seeded gap is already covered by an existing pull request, plus the matched PR (or null). `verdict` is the composable decision a downstream router switches on; `match` carries the PR that drove it (number/title/state/merged/url) for audit / 'duplicate of #N' follow-ups. Distinct from ClaimVerdict ({allow,reason}, the pace/drift claim-gate output) — this is a three-way seed/skip/downgrade gate over PR state, not a binary worker-claim gate.
